SubKiller (\"we\", \"our\", or \"us\") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how your information is handled when you use our app.
1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT We do NOT collect, store, or share any personal information on our servers. All subscriptions you add (names, prices, dates, categories) are stored ONLY on your local device using Android\'s secure Room database.
2. NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED SubKiller does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal details. You can use the app fully offline.
3. NO BANK ACCESS We do not connect to your bank, credit card, or payment services. All subscription data is manually entered by you.
4. THIRD-PARTY ADVERTISING This app uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob may collect and use certain data (such as your device\'s advertising ID) to provide personalized ads. You can learn more about how Google uses data at: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites
5. LOCAL NOTIFICATIONS SubKiller sends local notifications to remind you about upcoming payments. These are generated on your device and do not require internet access. You can disable them anytime in the app Settings.
6. DATA SECURITY All your data stays on your device. If you uninstall the app, all your subscription data will be permanently deleted. We recommend exporting important records manually.
7. CHILDREN\'S PRIVACY Our app does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
8. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes are effective immediately upon posting.
9. CONTACT US If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: cartoniq.business@gmail.com
By using SubKiller, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
